name: Puberty
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of godly instruction and discipline during the formative years, which includes the period of puberty. Proverbs highlights the role of parents in teaching and correcting their children, promising that proper training and timely chastening bring lasting guidance and peace. This foundation prepares young people for the covenantal relationship of marriage described in Genesis, where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife as one flesh. Thus, puberty is a critical time for instilling biblical values that shape character and future faithfulness.
